newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK CONSERVATIVES WANT PARLIAMENT INVESTIGATING COMMITTEE.
newsitem.headline: GREEK CONSERVATIVES WANT PARLIAMENT INVESTIGATING COMMITTEE.

text.p: Seventy seven MPs of conservative opposition New Democracy submitted a proposal to parliament president Apostolos Kaklamanis asking for a parliamentary investigating committee to look into the bourse crisis.

"In all economically developed countries the stock market is a significant lever for economic growth. Transparency and credibility in the operations of the stock exchange is an indispensable presupposition for the economy's growth," the New Democracy proposal said.
It said the crisis had undermined the credibility of the Athens stock exchange domestically and abroad.
It slammed the national economy ministry for trying to cover up the case through various methods and hide the responsibilities of individuals and corporate entities possibly involved in fraud.

"The government used the state bank subsidiary brokerages as union busters even though they are also responsible for the scandal," New Democracy said in its proposal. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
